findings.label: false-alarm
findings.why: The warning concerns the untested DeliveryRequest.verified cell in a preview stage, unrelated to the new replaced_commit property, and does not indicate a real problem with this change (none was seeded).

edit.why: It adds an optional replaced_commit property to DeliveryRequest, but nothing ties it to the deploy action so it is filled on deploy, and it also changes the source ref and downgrades the status from confirmed to proposed.
